decisions.decision: X-Scanner header fixes Connect auth — CLI-port approach rejected by Fable5 review
decisions.rationale: CLI port also requires auth when password protection enabled; echo response masks failures. X-Scanner is LMS's official backend-process auth mechanism, used by Spotty and the LMS scanner.

decisions.decision: The missing X-Scanner header was a regression from the Spotty→SpotOn port
decisions.rationale: Spotty's lms.rs:104 had X-Scanner unconditionally; SpotOn's connect.rs lost it during rewrite
